strings.privacy_sub: What the app stores and where
strings.privacy_body:
Gharcha has no account, no server and no ads. Everything you enter (expenses, members, budgets, PINs as scrambled hashes) is stored only in this phone and leaves it only when you export or share it yourself.

The microphone is used only while you tap the mic for voice entry; speech is turned into text by your phone's speech service. Notifications are scheduled on the phone. Pasting a payment message reads the clipboard only when you tap paste.

Erase all data in Your data removes everything.
